versions.changelog: The helper connects through Beatra's mainland network when your computer is in mainland China, and can open the approval page on Beatra's international site when you need another sign-in method.
The helper now waits for your approval, and if you approve after it has stopped waiting, Beatra connects automatically the next time you use it, with no second approval.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

wechat-channels-product-video v0.1.7

- Clarified workflow: Now explicitly stops at script/draft stage without confirmed product information (prevents unnecessary paid work).
- Updated documentation: SKILL.md revised to emphasize the requirement for confirmed product facts before producing video, not just writing copy.
- Cleaned up files: Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
- Minor code and manifest updates for improved clarity and maintainability.
- No user-facing feature changes to video generation routes or core client behavior.
Ask for the starter top-up before this video starts, using the live price card.
Publish the reviewed WeChat Channels Product Showcase Video Maker workflow with its English ClawHub listing.
